verdict.rationale: MailerSend publishes an API reference with endpoint pages such as the Email API and Webhooks, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive console, a try-it feature, or runnable examples. Probes for an OpenAPI or Swagger spec all returned 404, so there is also no machine-readable spec that would back an interactive explorer. A static reference alone does not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
